text: Could you add a caption over this pic for me? It reminds me of those rare moments when I can finally slow down a bit. The words should be “A little room to breathe,” near the bottom in clean white lettering. Please keep the whole wide photo. I always seem to overthink even a small thing like adding a few words to a picture. Just add the caption and leave everything else alone.
